name: Ames National Laboratory
whyRelevant: A DOE laboratory with student and research pathways in materials, quantum systems, scientific software and laboratory instrumentation.
relevanceEn: Useful for quantum-device, scientific-computing and measurement-system pathways adjacent to semiconductor engineering.
relevanceZh: 适合量子器件、科学计算与测量系统等半导体相邻路径。
descriptionEn: Ames National Laboratory is a U.S. Department of Energy laboratory operated by Iowa State University, specializing in critical materials, quantum materials, chemical science and computational discovery.
descriptionZh: 艾姆斯国家实验室是由爱荷华州立大学运营的美国能源部国家实验室，重点研究关键材料、量子材料、化学科学与计算发现。

evidence.title: Ames National Laboratory Careers and Internships

name: Brookhaven National Laboratory
nameZh: 布鲁克海文国家实验室
whyRelevant: BNL leads the C2QA quantum center and hires engineers for detectors, controls, computing and advanced scientific facilities.
relevanceEn: Strong research route for quantum control, detector electronics and scientific software.
relevanceZh: 量子控制、探测器电子学与科学软件方向的重要研究型机会。
descriptionEn: Brookhaven National Laboratory is a DOE Office of Science laboratory conducting research in nuclear science, quantum information, materials, accelerators and large-scale computing.
descriptionZh: 布鲁克海文国家实验室隶属美国能源部科学办公室，开展核科学、量子信息、材料、加速器与大规模计算研究。

name: Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory
nameZh: 费米国家加速器实验室
whyRelevant: Fermilab combines FPGA-heavy detector systems, timing, controls, scientific software and superconducting quantum research.
relevanceEn: A strong bridge from FPGA and verification work into detector electronics, timing systems and quantum instrumentation.
relevanceZh: 可将 FPGA 与验证经验迁移到探测器电子学、时序系统和量子仪器。
descriptionEn: Fermilab is the U.S. particle-physics and accelerator laboratory and leads the Superconducting Quantum Materials and Systems Center.
descriptionZh: 费米实验室是美国粒子物理与加速器国家实验室，并牵头超导量子材料与系统中心。

name: Idaho National Laboratory
whyRelevant: INL provides cyber-physical, digital engineering, controls and advanced-manufacturing roles, though many programs carry citizenship gates.
relevanceEn: Relevant to secure embedded systems, diagnostics and automation; eligibility must be checked at requisition level.
relevanceZh: 与安全嵌入式系统、诊断和自动化相关，但必须逐岗位核验身份资格。
descriptionEn: Idaho National Laboratory is a DOE multiprogram laboratory focused on nuclear energy, critical infrastructure security, advanced manufacturing and energy systems.
descriptionZh: 爱达荷国家实验室是美国能源部多任务国家实验室，重点覆盖核能、关键基础设施安全、先进制造与能源系统。

name: National Energy Technology Laboratory
whyRelevant: NETL has instrumentation, modeling and automation work, but as a government-operated laboratory its federal hiring gates are central.
relevanceEn: A secondary route for instrumentation and modeling with high eligibility-review priority.
relevanceZh: 属于仪器与建模的补充路径，身份资格核验优先级很高。
descriptionEn: NETL is DOE's government-owned, government-operated national laboratory for energy technology, carbon management, materials and computational research.
descriptionZh: 国家能源技术实验室是美国能源部直接运营的国家实验室，研究能源技术、碳管理、材料与计算科学。

name: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory
nameZh: 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室
whyRelevant: PPPL needs real-time control, diagnostic electronics and scientific-software talent for fusion experiments.
relevanceEn: Useful for FPGA, control-system and data-acquisition engineering outside conventional chip companies.
relevanceZh: 适合将 FPGA、控制系统与数据采集能力迁移到聚变实验工程。
descriptionEn: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory is a DOE national laboratory managed by Princeton University and dedicated to fusion energy science and advanced plasma technology.
descriptionZh: 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室是由普林斯顿大学管理、专注聚变能源科学与先进等离子体技术的能源部国家实验室。

name: Savannah River National Laboratory
whyRelevant: SRNL operates sensor, automation and robotics programs in hazardous environments, with substantial position-specific security constraints.
relevanceEn: An adjacent path for rugged automation and sensing; citizenship and clearance gates are common.
relevanceZh: 适合严苛环境自动化与传感方向，但公民身份和许可限制较常见。
descriptionEn: Savannah River National Laboratory is DOE's environmental-management national laboratory, applying science and engineering to nuclear materials, cleanup, security and resilient infrastructure.
descriptionZh: 萨凡纳河国家实验室是美国能源部环境管理国家实验室，将科学工程用于核材料、环境治理、安全与韧性基础设施。

name: SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory
nameZh: SLAC 国家加速器实验室
whyRelevant: SLAC offers unusually strong California opportunities in FPGA readout, real-time controls, custom electronics and quantum science.
relevanceEn: A high-value research target for FPGA, RTL, timing, data acquisition and scientific infrastructure.
relevanceZh: 是 FPGA、RTL、时序、数据采集与科研基础设施方向的高价值目标。
descriptionEn: SLAC is a DOE national laboratory operated by Stanford University, building accelerators, photon-science facilities, detectors and quantum research platforms.
descriptionZh: SLAC 是由斯坦福大学运营的能源部国家实验室，建设加速器、光子科学设施、探测器与量子研究平台。

name: Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility
nameZh: 托马斯·杰斐逊国家加速器设施
whyRelevant: Jefferson Lab builds accelerator controls and detector systems that use FPGA, embedded and high-speed data skills.
relevanceEn: A practical route into scientific electronics, firmware and controls engineering.
relevanceZh: 进入科研电子、固件与控制工程的务实路径。
descriptionEn: Jefferson Lab is a DOE nuclear-physics laboratory centered on the CEBAF accelerator, detector systems, superconducting RF and scientific computing.
descriptionZh: 杰斐逊实验室是围绕 CEBAF 加速器开展核物理研究的能源部实验室，覆盖探测器、超导射频与科学计算。

name: The Aerospace Corporation
whyRelevant: Aerospace operates the Air Force space FFRDC and hires for trusted electronics, radiation analysis and space-system engineering.
relevanceEn: Technically aligned with silicon reliability and system modeling, but many roles require U.S. citizenship or clearance eligibility.
relevanceZh: 技术上匹配芯片可靠性与系统建模，但许多岗位要求美国公民身份或安全许可资格。
descriptionEn: The Aerospace Corporation is a nonprofit FFRDC providing independent technical expertise for U.S. national-security space programs.
descriptionZh: The Aerospace Corporation 是为美国国家安全航天项目提供独立技术支持的非营利联邦资助研发中心。

name: MITRE
whyRelevant: MITRE operates multiple FFRDCs and works on trusted hardware, cyber-physical systems and advanced computing.
relevanceEn: Good technical fit for hardware security and systems research; citizenship gates are common.
relevanceZh: 适合硬件安全与系统研究，但公民身份限制常见。
descriptionEn: MITRE is a nonprofit technology organization that operates U.S. government FFRDCs across defense, aviation, cybersecurity and public-sector systems.
descriptionZh: MITRE 是运营多个美国政府联邦资助研发中心的非营利技术机构，覆盖国防、航空、网络安全与公共系统。

name: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory
nameZh: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室
whyRelevant: APL develops mission hardware, FPGA systems, sensors and spacecraft instruments with strong hands-on engineering depth.
relevanceEn: Technically attractive for FPGA and embedded work, with frequent citizenship or clearance constraints.
relevanceZh: FPGA 与嵌入式技术匹配度高，但公民身份或安全许可限制频繁。
descriptionEn: JHU APL is a university-affiliated research center performing applied research and engineering for national security, space, health and critical infrastructure.
descriptionZh: JHU APL 是大学附属研究中心，为国家安全、航天、健康与关键基础设施开展应用研究和工程研发。

name: Draper
whyRelevant: Draper is an applied R&D employer for navigation, embedded electronics, ASICs and autonomous systems.
relevanceEn: A strong technical target for mission electronics; eligibility restrictions must be checked per role.
relevanceZh: 任务电子系统技术匹配度高，需逐岗位核验身份限制。
descriptionEn: Draper is an independent nonprofit engineering laboratory known for guidance, navigation, autonomy, secure systems and biomedical technology.
descriptionZh: Draper 是独立非营利工程实验室，以制导、导航、自主系统、安全系统与生物医疗技术著称。

name: Georgia Tech Research Institute
whyRelevant: GTRI runs applied engineering programs in FPGA systems, sensing, autonomy and electronic systems.
relevanceEn: Good for DSP, FPGA and hardware-software prototyping, with common project-level citizenship gates.
relevanceZh: 适合 DSP、FPGA 与软硬件原型，但项目级公民身份限制常见。
descriptionEn: GTRI is Georgia Tech's applied research organization serving government and industry across sensing, defense electronics, cybersecurity and autonomous systems.
descriptionZh: GTRI 是佐治亚理工的应用研究机构，面向政府和产业开展传感、国防电子、网络安全与自主系统研发。

name: Southwest Research Institute
whyRelevant: SwRI offers project-based engineering across embedded electronics, automation, vehicles, space and measurement systems.
relevanceEn: A broad applied-R&D target where demonstrable prototypes can matter more than a narrow pedigree.
relevanceZh: 属于广泛的应用研发目标，工程原型证据往往比单一背景标签更重要。
descriptionEn: Southwest Research Institute is an independent nonprofit R&D organization performing contract research for industry and government.
descriptionZh: 西南研究院是独立非营利研发机构，为产业和政府提供合同研究与工程服务。

name: SRI International
whyRelevant: SRI combines California research roles with robotics, sensing, advanced computing and government-funded prototypes.
relevanceEn: A useful research-engineer target for integrated hardware, software and AI systems.
relevanceZh: 适合软硬件与 AI 一体化系统的研究工程师路径。
descriptionEn: SRI International is an independent nonprofit research institute commercializing and deploying technology across AI, robotics, sensing, communications and bioscience.
descriptionZh: SRI International 是独立非营利研究机构，开展 AI、机器人、传感、通信与生物科学技术研发和转化。

name: Carnegie Mellon Software Engineering Institute
nameZh: 卡内基梅隆大学软件工程研究所
whyRelevant: SEI is adjacent to hardware through assurance, cyber-physical systems and reliable AI-enabled engineering workflows.
relevanceEn: Useful for the agentic engineering narrative, though it is not a direct silicon-design employer.
relevanceZh: 有利于 Agent 工程叙事，但不是直接的芯片设计雇主。
descriptionEn: CMU SEI is a Department of Defense FFRDC focused on software engineering, cybersecurity, AI engineering and mission-system assurance.
descriptionZh: CMU SEI 是美国国防部联邦资助研发中心，重点研究软件工程、网络安全、AI 工程与任务系统保障。

name: Institute for Defense Analyses
whyRelevant: IDA operates FFRDCs with computing and microelectronics analysis, but citizenship and clearance requirements are substantial.
relevanceEn: Include as a restricted branch for technical analysis roles, not as a default internship target.
relevanceZh: 应作为受限分支保留，用于技术分析岗位，而不是默认实习目标。
descriptionEn: IDA is a nonprofit corporation operating U.S. government FFRDCs for objective national-security analysis and advanced technical research.
descriptionZh: IDA 是为美国政府运营联邦资助研发中心的非营利机构，开展国家安全分析与先进技术研究。

name: Noblis
whyRelevant: Noblis runs technical research for federal missions, including communications and cyber-physical systems.
relevanceEn: A secondary systems route with significant project-specific citizenship constraints.
relevanceZh: 属于系统工程补充路径，项目级公民身份限制显著。
descriptionEn: Noblis is an independent nonprofit science and technology organization serving U.S. federal missions in security, transportation, health and communications.
descriptionZh: Noblis 是独立非营利科技机构，为美国联邦安全、交通、健康与通信任务提供研发支持。

name: Riverside Research
whyRelevant: Riverside Research explicitly works on trusted and assured microelectronics for national-security systems.
relevanceEn: Direct topical fit for hardware security, with restrictive eligibility on many programs.
relevanceZh: 硬件安全主题直接匹配，但许多项目资格限制严格。
descriptionEn: Riverside Research is a nonprofit research organization conducting mission-focused work in microelectronics, electromagnetics, intelligence, space and AI.
descriptionZh: Riverside Research 是非营利研究机构，开展微电子、电磁、情报、航天与 AI 等任务导向研发。

name: Battelle
whyRelevant: Battelle conducts applied R&D and manages multiple national laboratories, creating both corporate and laboratory routes.
relevanceEn: Useful for materials, secure hardware, manufacturing and research infrastructure.
relevanceZh: 适合材料、安全硬件、制造与科研基础设施方向。
descriptionEn: Battelle is a nonprofit science and technology organization that performs contract R&D and helps manage major U.S. national laboratories.
descriptionZh: Battelle 是开展合同研发并参与管理多所美国国家实验室的非营利科技机构。

name: HRL Laboratories
whyRelevant: HRL is a rare Southern California employer spanning semiconductor fabrication, silicon quantum devices and advanced computing.
relevanceEn: High technical fit and geographic value, but many roles require U.S. person or clearance eligibility.
relevanceZh: 技术与地理匹配度很高，但许多岗位要求美国人资格或安全许可。
descriptionEn: HRL Laboratories is an industrial research laboratory owned by Boeing and General Motors, developing advanced microelectronics, materials, sensors and quantum systems.
descriptionZh: HRL 实验室由波音和通用汽车共同拥有，研发先进微电子、材料、传感器与量子系统。

name: National Radio Astronomy Observatory
whyRelevant: NRAO builds large digital backends, correlators, receivers and control systems with direct FPGA and DSP relevance.
relevanceEn: A strong nontraditional target for DSP hardware, high-speed data paths and scientific software.
relevanceZh: 是 DSP 硬件、高速数据通路与科学软件的强力非传统目标。
descriptionEn: NRAO is an NSF FFRDC operating major U.S. radio telescopes and developing the receivers, digital electronics, control software and computing behind them.
descriptionZh: NRAO 是美国国家科学基金会资助的研发中心，运营大型射电望远镜并研发其接收机、数字电子、控制软件与计算系统。

name: NSF National Center for Atmospheric Research
nameEn: NSF National Center for Atmospheric Research
nameZh: 美国国家大气研究中心
whyRelevant: NCAR offers HPC, instrumentation, distributed data and scientific-software engineering outside defense-heavy federal research.
relevanceEn: A viable research-computing route with less direct silicon content but strong systems depth.
relevanceZh: 芯片内容较少，但属于系统深度强的科研计算路径。
descriptionEn: NSF NCAR is a federally funded research center managed by UCAR, providing atmospheric-science facilities, supercomputing, observing systems and community models.
descriptionZh: NSF NCAR 是由 UCAR 管理的联邦资助研发中心，提供大气科学设施、超级计算、观测系统与社区模型。

name: NSF NOIRLab
nameZh: 美国国家光学红外天文学研究实验室
whyRelevant: NOIRLab develops detector, control and data systems for major observatories, including Rubin Observatory.
relevanceEn: A useful route for sensors, real-time controls and high-volume scientific data.
relevanceZh: 适合传感器、实时控制与大规模科研数据方向。
descriptionEn: NSF NOIRLab is the U.S. national center for ground-based optical-infrared astronomy and operates major observatories, instruments and data services.
descriptionZh: NSF NOIRLab 是美国地基光学与红外天文学国家中心，运营大型天文台、仪器与数据服务。

name: National Solar Observatory
whyRelevant: NSO operates precision instruments and real-time control systems where hardware-software integration is central.
relevanceEn: An instrumentation route for controls, sensors and data acquisition.
relevanceZh: 面向控制、传感器与数据采集的仪器工程路径。
descriptionEn: The National Solar Observatory is an NSF FFRDC operating U.S. solar-observation facilities and developing advanced optical, control and data systems.
descriptionZh: 美国国家太阳天文台是 NSF 联邦资助研发中心，运营太阳观测设施并研发先进光学、控制与数据系统。

name: Lockheed Martin
whyRelevant: Lockheed Martin has substantial FPGA, ASIC, embedded and space-electronics hiring, but most U.S. hardware roles are citizenship-gated.
relevanceEn: Keep as a restricted branch for role-specific eligibility review rather than deleting the company.
relevanceZh: 应作为受限分支保留并逐岗位核验，而不是整家公司删除。
descriptionEn: Lockheed Martin is a U.S. aerospace and defense company building aircraft, missiles, space systems, sensors, mission electronics and command systems.
descriptionZh: 洛克希德·马丁是美国航空航天与国防公司，研制飞机、导弹、航天系统、传感器、任务电子与指挥系统。

name: Northrop Grumman
whyRelevant: Northrop Grumman operates semiconductor, radar, spacecraft and embedded-compute programs with direct RTL relevance and strict eligibility gates.
relevanceEn: Technically direct but generally unsuitable without U.S. citizenship for cleared programs.
relevanceZh: 技术方向直接匹配，但涉密项目通常不适合无美国公民身份者。
descriptionEn: Northrop Grumman is a U.S. aerospace and defense company producing spacecraft, aircraft, sensors, communications systems and mission electronics.
descriptionZh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼是美国航空航天与国防公司，生产航天器、飞机、传感器、通信系统与任务电子。

name: Boeing
whyRelevant: Boeing spans commercial avionics and defense-space electronics; eligibility varies sharply by business and requisition.
relevanceEn: Commercial-aircraft roles can differ from defense roles, so the branch must remain requisition-specific.
relevanceZh: 商用飞机与国防业务的身份要求差异很大，必须逐岗位判断。
descriptionEn: Boeing designs and manufactures commercial aircraft, defense systems, satellites, spacecraft, avionics and related services.
descriptionZh: 波音设计制造商用飞机、国防系统、卫星、航天器、航空电子并提供相关服务。

name: General Dynamics Mission Systems
whyRelevant: GDMS has extensive FPGA and embedded hardware roles, mostly tied to U.S. defense programs.
relevanceEn: Direct skill fit, but citizenship and clearance gates dominate.
relevanceZh: 技能直接匹配，但公民身份和安全许可是主导门槛。
descriptionEn: General Dynamics Mission Systems develops secure communications, command systems, sensors, computers and mission electronics for defense customers.
descriptionZh: 通用动力任务系统为国防客户研发安全通信、指挥系统、传感器、计算机与任务电子。

name: L3Harris Technologies
whyRelevant: L3Harris is a major FPGA, DSP and secure-radio employer with strong technical overlap and high eligibility friction.
relevanceEn: Preserve as a restricted target for learning the role taxonomy and checking any non-cleared exceptions.
relevanceZh: 作为受限目标保留，用于了解岗位体系并寻找少量非涉密例外。
descriptionEn: L3Harris is a defense-technology company producing tactical communications, sensors, electronic-warfare systems, avionics and space payloads.
descriptionZh: L3Harris 是国防技术公司，生产战术通信、传感器、电子战系统、航空电子与航天载荷。

name: BAE Systems, Inc.
whyRelevant: BAE Systems has radiation-hardened microelectronics and FPGA work, but U.S. defense eligibility is usually mandatory.
relevanceEn: Strong silicon relevance, but practical accessibility is low unless the exact role's citizenship, clearance, and export-control requirements are met.
relevanceZh: 芯片相关性很强，但只有满足具体岗位的公民身份、安全许可与出口管制条件时才具有现实可达性。
descriptionEn: BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems, developing electronic-warfare, space, vehicle and mission-system technologies.
descriptionZh: BAE Systems, Inc. 是 BAE Systems 的美国子公司，研发电子战、航天、车辆与任务系统技术。

name: Leidos
whyRelevant: Leidos integrates complex government systems and employs embedded and hardware engineers, with many program-specific restrictions.
relevanceEn: Adjacent systems route with citizenship constraints on a large share of openings.
relevanceZh: 属于系统工程相邻路径，大量岗位存在公民身份限制。
descriptionEn: Leidos is a U.S. technology integrator delivering defense, intelligence, space, aviation, health and civil-government systems.
descriptionZh: Leidos 是美国技术集成商，为国防、情报、航天、航空、医疗与政府部门交付系统。

name: SAIC
whyRelevant: SAIC can offer digital engineering and mission-computing roles, but it is less directly silicon-focused and frequently clearance-gated.
relevanceEn: A low-priority adjacent route for systems tooling and modeling.
relevanceZh: 属于系统工具与建模的低优先级相邻路径。
descriptionEn: SAIC is a U.S. government technology contractor providing engineering, digital transformation and mission-integration services.
descriptionZh: SAIC 是美国政府技术承包商，提供工程、数字化转型与任务集成服务。

name: Honeywell Aerospace Technologies
nameZh: 霍尼韦尔航空航天技术
whyRelevant: Honeywell Aerospace has a large Arizona footprint and commercial as well as defense avionics roles.
relevanceEn: A broader aerospace target where some commercial roles may be more accessible than cleared defense work.
relevanceZh: 航空航天机会较广，部分商用业务岗位可能比涉密国防岗位更可达。
descriptionEn: Honeywell Aerospace Technologies produces avionics, engines, navigation, flight controls, sensors and connected aircraft systems.
descriptionZh: 霍尼韦尔航空航天技术生产航空电子、发动机、导航、飞控、传感器与联网航空系统。

name: General Atomics
whyRelevant: General Atomics combines Southern California autonomous aircraft, fusion, sensing and power-electronics programs.
relevanceEn: Geographically relevant but many openings are U.S.-person or clearance constrained.
relevanceZh: 地理位置相关，但许多岗位受美国人资格或安全许可限制。
descriptionEn: General Atomics is a diversified technology company working on uncrewed aircraft, fusion energy, electromagnetic systems, sensors and nuclear technologies.
descriptionZh: 通用原子公司是多元技术企业，研发无人机、聚变能源、电磁系统、传感器与核技术。

name: Kratos Defense
whyRelevant: Kratos has California embedded and RF work but is predominantly defense-funded.
relevanceEn: A restricted secondary target for embedded, RF and autonomous-system roles.
relevanceZh: 嵌入式、射频与自主系统方向的受限次级目标。
descriptionEn: Kratos develops affordable defense systems, uncrewed aircraft, satellite communications, propulsion and microwave electronics.
descriptionZh: Kratos 研发低成本国防系统、无人机、卫星通信、推进系统与微波电子。

name: AeroVironment
whyRelevant: AeroVironment builds autonomous aircraft and robotic systems with embedded and FPGA work, generally for defense customers.
relevanceEn: Technically relevant robotics hardware with major eligibility friction.
relevanceZh: 机器人硬件技术相关，但身份资格摩擦较大。
descriptionEn: AeroVironment develops uncrewed aircraft, loitering systems, ground robots, sensors and autonomy software.
descriptionZh: AeroVironment 研发无人机、巡飞系统、地面机器人、传感器与自主软件。

name: Textron Systems
whyRelevant: Textron Systems adds another autonomous and sensor-hardware branch, usually with U.S. citizenship requirements.
relevanceEn: A restricted systems target rather than a primary application lane.
relevanceZh: 属于受限系统工程目标，不应作为主投递路线。
descriptionEn: Textron Systems develops uncrewed systems, electronic warfare, sensors, armored vehicles and precision weapons.
descriptionZh: 德事隆系统研发无人系统、电子战、传感器、装甲车辆与精确武器。

name: Sierra Nevada Corporation
whyRelevant: SNC employs avionics, electronics and embedded engineers across aircraft and space programs.
relevanceEn: A restricted aerospace branch with real hardware depth.
relevanceZh: 具有真实硬件深度的受限航空航天分支。
descriptionEn: Sierra Nevada Corporation is a private aerospace and national-security company developing aircraft systems, avionics, sensors and space technologies.
descriptionZh: 塞拉内华达公司是私营航空航天与国家安全企业，研发飞机系统、航空电子、传感器与航天技术。

name: Blue Origin
whyRelevant: Blue Origin has high-value avionics, FPGA and test-automation roles but export-control eligibility is central.
relevanceEn: A stretch hardware target whose accessibility depends on U.S.-person status wording.
relevanceZh: 属于冲刺硬件目标，可达性取决于岗位中的美国人资格表述。
descriptionEn: Blue Origin develops reusable launch vehicles, rocket engines, spacecraft and lunar systems with vertically integrated avionics and manufacturing.
descriptionZh: Blue Origin 研发可重复使用运载器、火箭发动机、航天器与月球系统，并自研航空电子和制造体系。

name: Rocket Lab USA
whyRelevant: Rocket Lab builds launch vehicles and satellite components in Southern California with strong embedded and avionics demand.
relevanceEn: A geographically attractive stretch target gated by export-control rules.
relevanceZh: 地理位置理想的冲刺目标，但受出口管制规则约束。
descriptionEn: Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company producing launch vehicles, spacecraft, solar power systems, radios and satellite components.
descriptionZh: Rocket Lab 是端到端航天企业，生产运载火箭、航天器、太阳能系统、无线电与卫星部件。

name: Sierra Space
whyRelevant: Sierra Space develops spacecraft and station systems with embedded, avionics and test roles.
relevanceEn: A space-systems target with export-control constraints and volatile hiring volume.
relevanceZh: 属于受出口管制约束、招聘规模波动较大的航天系统目标。
descriptionEn: Sierra Space develops the Dream Chaser spaceplane, orbital habitats, spacecraft systems and related propulsion technology.
descriptionZh: Sierra Space 研发 Dream Chaser 航天飞机、轨道舱、航天器系统与相关推进技术。

name: Axiom Space
whyRelevant: Axiom Space has spacecraft electronics and test work around commercial space-station development.
relevanceEn: An adjacent stretch target with export-control and program-timing risk.
relevanceZh: 属于受出口管制和项目节奏影响的相邻冲刺目标。
descriptionEn: Axiom Space develops commercial human-spaceflight missions, spacesuits and a planned commercial space station.
descriptionZh: Axiom Space 开发商业载人航天任务、航天服与计划中的商业空间站。

name: Relativity Space
whyRelevant: Relativity Space combines Long Beach avionics, test automation and digitally driven manufacturing.
relevanceEn: A local stretch target for hardware automation and flight electronics.
relevanceZh: 本地硬件自动化与飞行电子方向的冲刺目标。
descriptionEn: Relativity Space develops launch vehicles using highly automated design, testing and additive-manufacturing systems.
descriptionZh: Relativity Space 通过高度自动化的设计、测试与增材制造系统研发运载火箭。

name: Firefly Aerospace
whyRelevant: Firefly develops launch and lunar systems with hands-on avionics roles and export-control gates.
relevanceEn: A focused space-hardware target with limited accessibility for non-U.S. persons.
relevanceZh: 聚焦航天硬件，但对非美国人可达性有限。
descriptionEn: Firefly Aerospace builds launch vehicles, lunar landers and orbital vehicles for commercial and government space missions.
descriptionZh: Firefly Aerospace 为商业和政府航天任务制造运载火箭、月球着陆器与轨道飞行器。

name: Shield AI
whyRelevant: Shield AI is a high-growth autonomy employer in San Diego with embedded and compute roles, but defense eligibility is a major gate.
relevanceEn: Strong systems fit and local relevance, with citizenship constraints on many positions.
relevanceZh: 系统匹配度与地理相关性强，但许多岗位有公民身份限制。
descriptionEn: Shield AI develops autonomy software, aircraft and edge-compute systems for defense operations in denied environments.
descriptionZh: Shield AI 为受限环境中的国防行动研发自主软件、飞行器与边缘计算系统。

name: Varda Space Industries
whyRelevant: Varda is a nearby El Segundo startup with spacecraft electronics and automation-heavy manufacturing.
relevanceEn: A local stretch target with strong build-test ownership and export-control gates.
relevanceZh: 本地冲刺目标，强调端到端构建测试，但受出口管制限制。
descriptionEn: Varda Space Industries develops reentry spacecraft and in-space manufacturing platforms for pharmaceutical and advanced-material production.
descriptionZh: Varda 航天工业研发再入航天器与在轨制造平台，用于药物和先进材料生产。

name: Stoke Space
whyRelevant: Stoke Space is developing a fully reusable rocket and hires for avionics, controls and test systems.
relevanceEn: High ownership but export-controlled and startup-risky.
relevanceZh: 岗位所有权高，但同时存在出口管制与初创公司风险。
descriptionEn: Stoke Space is a launch startup developing a fully reusable two-stage orbital rocket and its engines, avionics and ground systems.
descriptionZh: Stoke Space 是研发两级完全可重复使用轨道火箭及其发动机、航空电子和地面系统的初创公司。

name: Astranis
whyRelevant: Astranis builds communications satellites in-house and hires for FPGA, digital hardware and embedded systems.
relevanceEn: Direct technical fit for RTL and FPGA work, with U.S.-person export-control requirements common.
relevanceZh: RTL 与 FPGA 技术直接匹配，但美国人出口管制资格要求常见。
descriptionEn: Astranis designs and manufactures small geostationary communications satellites, including payload electronics, radios and flight computers.
descriptionZh: Astranis 设计制造小型地球同步通信卫星，包括载荷电子、无线电与飞行计算机。

name: Capella Space
whyRelevant: Capella combines radar DSP, satellite electronics and data infrastructure in a compact engineering organization.
relevanceEn: Good FPGA and DSP fit, with export-control eligibility risk.
relevanceZh: FPGA 与 DSP 匹配度高，但存在出口管制资格风险。
descriptionEn: Capella Space, acquired by IonQ in 2025, retains its own active careers page and operates a commercial synthetic-aperture-radar satellite constellation while building spacecraft, payload and data systems.
descriptionZh: Capella Space 于 2025 年被 IonQ 收购，但仍保留独立且活跃的招聘入口；其运营商业合成孔径雷达卫星星座，并研发航天器、载荷与数据系统。

evidence.title: IonQ Completes Acquisition of Capella Space

name: D-Wave Quantum
whyRelevant: D-Wave designs superconducting quantum processors and control systems with U.S. operations and now includes the acquired Quantum Circuits gate-model team.
relevanceEn: A stretch route into quantum IC, cryogenic electronics and hardware-software systems.
relevanceZh: 进入量子集成电路、低温电子与软硬件系统的冲刺路径。
descriptionEn: D-Wave is a quantum-computing company building annealing processors, gate-model systems through its acquired Quantum Circuits team, control hardware and cloud services.
descriptionZh: D-Wave 是量子计算公司，研发量子退火处理器，并通过已收购的 Quantum Circuits 团队开发门模型系统、控制硬件与云服务。

name: Atom Computing
whyRelevant: Atom Computing builds neutral-atom quantum computers that require control electronics, real-time systems and scientific software.
relevanceEn: Strong systems target for control hardware and automation, though quantum depth is a major gap.
relevanceZh: 控制硬件与自动化匹配度高，但量子专业深度是主要缺口。
descriptionEn: Atom Computing develops neutral-atom quantum computers using optically trapped atoms, precision lasers, control electronics and a full software stack.
descriptionZh: Atom Computing 利用光学俘获原子、精密激光、控制电子与完整软件栈研发中性原子量子计算机。

name: QuEra Computing
whyRelevant: QuEra co-develops neutral-atom hardware, control software and algorithms in Boston.
relevanceEn: A high-bar research target where FPGA and control experience can support a quantum pivot.
relevanceZh: 高门槛研究目标，FPGA 与控制经验可支持向量子方向转型。
descriptionEn: QuEra builds programmable neutral-atom quantum computers based on research from Harvard and MIT.
descriptionZh: QuEra 基于哈佛与 MIT 的研究成果研发可编程中性原子量子计算机。

name: Infleqtion
whyRelevant: Infleqtion spans neutral-atom computing, sensing, timing and software, producing diverse engineering entry points.
relevanceEn: A broad quantum target for controls, embedded systems and experimental automation.
relevanceZh: 控制、嵌入式系统与实验自动化方向的广泛量子目标。
descriptionEn: Infleqtion is a NYSE-listed quantum company developing neutral-atom quantum computers, atomic clocks, quantum sensors and quantum software products.
descriptionZh: Infleqtion 是纽约证券交易所上市的量子企业，研发中性原子量子计算机、原子钟、量子传感器与量子软件产品。

name: Qolab
whyRelevant: Qolab explicitly applies semiconductor-compatible fabrication and advanced packaging to scalable superconducting quantum processors.
relevanceEn: A direct semiconductor-to-quantum target for fabrication, integration, measurement and hardware systems.
relevanceZh: 从半导体制造、集成、测量与硬件系统切入量子方向的直接目标。
descriptionEn: Qolab develops superconducting quantum processors using semiconductor-compatible wafer fabrication, packaging and cryogenic integration.
descriptionZh: Qolab 利用兼容半导体产业的晶圆制造、封装与低温集成技术研发超导量子处理器。

name: SEEQC
whyRelevant: SEEQC is unusually close to conventional IC design because it integrates digital cryogenic control with superconducting quantum chips.
relevanceEn: One of the best quantum targets for an EDA, RTL and chip-design narrative.
relevanceZh: 是最适合 EDA、RTL 与芯片设计叙事的量子企业之一。
descriptionEn: SEEQC develops a digital quantum-computing platform using superconducting processors and energy-efficient single-flux-quantum control electronics.
descriptionZh: SEEQC 通过超导处理器与低功耗单磁通量量子控制电子研发数字量子计算平台。

name: Qblox
whyRelevant: Qblox builds FPGA-heavy, low-latency quantum control hardware and has active U.S. operations, making it a direct bridge from RTL, embedded systems and verification into quantum infrastructure.
relevanceEn: A high-fit quantum-enabling target for FPGA, embedded, electronics and systems-integration experience.
relevanceZh: 高度匹配 FPGA、嵌入式、电子与系统集成经验的量子使能型目标。
descriptionEn: Qblox develops scalable quantum-control electronics and software. It operates a Boston office and announced U.S. manufacturing, integration and support roles in Canton, Massachusetts.
descriptionZh: Qblox 研发可扩展量子控制电子与软件，在波士顿设有办公室，并已宣布在马萨诸塞州坎顿建设美国制造、集成与支持岗位。

evidence.title: Qblox Introduces First Made in America Quantum Control Systems

name: EeroQ
whyRelevant: EeroQ develops electron-spin quantum processors using semiconductor-like fabrication and cryogenic control.
relevanceEn: A semiconductor-adjacent quantum target with a steep physics requirement.
relevanceZh: 与半导体相邻的量子目标，但物理要求很高。
descriptionEn: EeroQ is building quantum computers based on electron spins floating above superfluid helium, with custom cryogenic hardware and control systems.
descriptionZh: EeroQ 基于超流氦表面电子自旋研发量子计算机，并自研低温硬件与控制系统。

name: Maybell Quantum
whyRelevant: Maybell builds the physical infrastructure around quantum processors, offering hardware roles that do not all require qubit-theory specialization.
relevanceEn: A practical quantum-adjacent route through test, controls and hardware infrastructure.
relevanceZh: 可通过测试、控制与硬件基础设施进入量子产业的务实路径。
descriptionEn: Maybell Quantum designs and manufactures cryogenic platforms, wiring and supporting infrastructure for quantum computers.
descriptionZh: Maybell Quantum 为量子计算机设计制造低温平台、布线与配套基础设施。

name: Q-CTRL
whyRelevant: Q-CTRL has a Los Angeles presence and develops automated control and error-suppression software for quantum hardware.
relevanceEn: A local bridge between agentic automation, controls and quantum engineering.
relevanceZh: 连接本地 Agent 自动化、控制与量子工程的桥梁。
descriptionEn: Q-CTRL builds quantum-control infrastructure software, error-suppression tools and quantum sensors for commercial and government users.
descriptionZh: Q-CTRL 为商业和政府用户开发量子控制基础设施软件、误差抑制工具与量子传感器。

name: Qunnect
whyRelevant: Qunnect builds room-temperature quantum-networking hardware and metropolitan testbeds.
relevanceEn: A specialized route into photonics, control electronics and networked quantum systems.
relevanceZh: 进入光子学、控制电子与量子网络系统的专业路径。
descriptionEn: Qunnect develops quantum-networking components and systems, including entanglement sources, quantum memories and network-management hardware.
descriptionZh: Qunnect 研发量子网络部件与系统，包括纠缠源、量子存储器与网络管理硬件。

name: Diraq
whyRelevant: Diraq uses CMOS-compatible silicon spin qubits and has an expanding U.S. presence.
relevanceEn: A direct semiconductor-to-quantum research target with a steep device-physics bar.
relevanceZh: 从半导体切入量子研究的直接目标，但器件物理门槛很高。
descriptionEn: Diraq is developing fault-tolerant quantum computers using silicon spin qubits manufactured with semiconductor-industry processes.
descriptionZh: Diraq 利用半导体工业工艺制造硅自旋量子比特，研发容错量子计算机。

name: Quantum Machines
whyRelevant: Quantum Machines builds FPGA-like real-time control platforms for quantum computers, closely matching hardware-software automation skills.
relevanceEn: One of the clearest quantum-enabling fits for FPGA, RTL, timing and developer tooling.
relevanceZh: 是 FPGA、RTL、时序与开发工具能力最清晰的量子配套企业之一。
descriptionEn: Quantum Machines develops hardware and software platforms for controlling, calibrating and operating quantum processors.
descriptionZh: Quantum Machines 开发用于控制、校准与运行量子处理器的软硬件平台。

name: Bluefors North America
whyRelevant: Bluefors supplies core cryogenic infrastructure to the quantum industry and has U.S. manufacturing through Cryomech.
relevanceEn: A less theory-heavy quantum route through equipment, test and applications engineering.
relevanceZh: 可通过设备、测试与应用工程进入量子产业，理论门槛相对较低。
descriptionEn: Bluefors designs and manufactures cryogenic measurement systems and dilution refrigerators used in quantum computing and low-temperature research.
descriptionZh: Bluefors 设计制造用于量子计算和低温研究的低温测量系统与稀释制冷机。

name: Robust AI
whyRelevant: Robust AI builds a software-defined industrial robot platform in the Bay Area, combining autonomy with deployable hardware.
relevanceEn: Useful for systems integration, diagnostics and AI-assisted robotics tooling.
relevanceZh: 适合系统集成、故障诊断与 AI 辅助机器人工具方向。
descriptionEn: Robust AI develops autonomous warehouse robots and a shared robotics platform designed for safe human collaboration and rapid deployment.
descriptionZh: Robust AI 研发自主仓储机器人与共享机器人平台，强调安全人机协作和快速部署。

name: Field AI
whyRelevant: Field AI is a Los Angeles-area robotics target developing general-purpose autonomy for complex physical environments.
relevanceEn: A Southern California stretch target for embodied AI, systems testing and robust deployment.
relevanceZh: 南加州具身 AI、系统测试与稳健部署方向的冲刺目标。
descriptionEn: Field AI develops risk-aware foundation models and autonomy software that can operate heterogeneous robots in unstructured industrial environments.
descriptionZh: Field AI 研发具备风险感知的基础模型与自主软件，使不同机器人能在非结构化工业环境中运行。

name: Skild AI
whyRelevant: Skild AI is building a general-purpose robotics foundation model with research and systems roles.
relevanceEn: A high-bar embodied-AI target where hardware systems evidence can differentiate from pure ML candidates.
relevanceZh: 高门槛具身 AI 目标，硬件系统证据可与纯 ML 候选人形成差异化。
descriptionEn: Skild AI trains general-purpose robot intelligence intended to transfer across robot bodies, tasks and physical environments.
descriptionZh: Skild AI 训练可跨机器人本体、任务与物理环境迁移的通用机器人智能。

name: Gecko Robotics
whyRelevant: Gecko Robotics deploys inspection robots in demanding industrial environments where reliability, diagnostics and sensor systems matter.
relevanceEn: A good engineering target for rugged hardware, automation and data-backed diagnostics.
relevanceZh: 适合严苛环境硬件、自动化与数据驱动诊断方向。
descriptionEn: Gecko Robotics builds wall-climbing inspection robots and an asset-intelligence platform for power, manufacturing, defense and infrastructure operators.
descriptionZh: Gecko Robotics 为电力、制造、国防与基础设施运营方研发爬壁检测机器人和资产智能平台。

name: Collaborative Robotics
whyRelevant: Collaborative Robotics is building a new mobile-manipulation platform with substantial hardware and systems ownership.
relevanceEn: A high-upside Bay Area target for end-to-end robot integration.
relevanceZh: 湾区端到端机器人集成方向的高潜力目标。
descriptionEn: Collaborative Robotics designs adaptable robots intended to work safely with people across logistics, manufacturing and service environments.
descriptionZh: Collaborative Robotics 设计可在物流、制造与服务环境中安全协同工作的通用机器人。

name: GrayMatter Robotics
whyRelevant: GrayMatter Robotics is near Los Angeles and deploys AI-guided industrial robots in real factories.
relevanceEn: A practical local target for controls, automation and customer-facing systems engineering.
relevanceZh: 本地控制、自动化与客户现场系统工程的务实目标。
descriptionEn: GrayMatter Robotics develops AI-powered robotic cells for sanding, polishing, grinding and other high-mix manufacturing tasks.
descriptionZh: GrayMatter Robotics 研发用于打磨、抛光、研磨等多品种制造任务的 AI 机器人工作站。

name: Mujin US
whyRelevant: Mujin develops controller technology and deploys industrial robot systems in U.S. logistics facilities.
relevanceEn: A direct industrial-automation route with strong integration and controls content.
relevanceZh: 控制与集成内容很强的直接工业自动化路径。
descriptionEn: Mujin builds intelligent robot controllers and turnkey automation systems for logistics and manufacturing.
descriptionZh: Mujin 为物流与制造业开发智能机器人控制器和交钥匙自动化系统。

name: Serve Robotics
whyRelevant: Serve Robotics operates delivery robots in Los Angeles and combines hardware, autonomy and fleet diagnostics.
relevanceEn: A local robotics target where robust deployment evidence matters.
relevanceZh: 本地机器人目标，稳健部署证据非常重要。
descriptionEn: Serve Robotics designs and operates autonomous sidewalk delivery robots for food and local-commerce networks.
descriptionZh: Serve Robotics 设计运营面向餐饮与本地商业网络的自主人行道配送机器人。

name: Starship Technologies
whyRelevant: Starship operates a large deployed fleet of delivery robots, creating practical reliability and operations roles.
relevanceEn: Useful for learning production robotics at fleet scale.
relevanceZh: 适合学习车队规模的量产机器人系统。
descriptionEn: Starship Technologies develops autonomous delivery robots used on campuses and in communities across the United States and Europe.
descriptionZh: Starship Technologies 研发在美国和欧洲校园与社区运行的自主配送机器人。

name: Gatik
whyRelevant: Gatik develops middle-mile autonomous trucks with vehicle-compute, embedded and validation roles.
relevanceEn: An applied autonomy target for hardware-software integration and safety validation.
relevanceZh: 面向软硬件集成与安全验证的应用自主驾驶目标。
descriptionEn: Gatik develops autonomous medium-duty trucks for fixed business-to-business logistics routes.
descriptionZh: Gatik 为固定企业物流路线研发自主中型卡车。

name: Torc Robotics
whyRelevant: Torc, a Daimler Truck subsidiary, develops production autonomous-trucking systems with significant validation and embedded work.
relevanceEn: A systems-heavy path into production autonomy and safety engineering.
relevanceZh: 进入量产自主驾驶与安全工程的系统型路径。
descriptionEn: Torc Robotics develops autonomous-driving systems for long-haul trucks and is an independent subsidiary of Daimler Truck.
descriptionZh: Torc Robotics 为长途卡车研发自主驾驶系统，是戴姆勒卡车的独立子公司。

name: May Mobility
whyRelevant: May Mobility deploys autonomous transit vehicles, creating hands-on systems, hardware and operations roles.
relevanceEn: A practical production-autonomy route outside the most hyped robotaxi companies.
relevanceZh: 避开最热门 Robotaxi 公司、进入量产自主系统的务实路径。
descriptionEn: May Mobility develops and operates autonomous shuttle services for cities, campuses and transit agencies.
descriptionZh: May Mobility 为城市、园区与交通机构开发运营自主接驳车服务。

name: Navitas Semiconductor
whyRelevant: Navitas is a Southern California power-semiconductor company integrating GaN devices, drivers and control functions.
relevanceEn: A local semiconductor target spanning IC design, device engineering, characterization and applications.
relevanceZh: 本地半导体目标，覆盖集成电路设计、器件、表征与应用工程。
descriptionEn: Navitas develops gallium-nitride power integrated circuits and silicon-carbide power devices for data centers, electric vehicles, solar and consumer electronics.
descriptionZh: 纳微半导体研发用于数据中心、电动汽车、光伏与消费电子的氮化镓功率集成电路和碳化硅功率器件。

name: Efficient Power Conversion
whyRelevant: EPC is an El Segundo GaN pioneer with device, IC, applications and laboratory roles.
relevanceEn: A nearby power-semiconductor target where hands-on characterization matters.
relevanceZh: 邻近的功率半导体目标，重视动手表征能力。
descriptionEn: Efficient Power Conversion designs enhancement-mode gallium-nitride transistors and integrated circuits for high-efficiency power conversion.
descriptionZh: 宜普电源转换公司设计用于高效电能转换的增强型氮化镓晶体管与集成电路。

name: Everspin Technologies
whyRelevant: Everspin is a rare U.S. MRAM manufacturer with Arizona design, test and process opportunities.
relevanceEn: A direct extension of memory-system interests into nonvolatile memory devices and products.
relevanceZh: 可将存储系统兴趣延伸到非易失存储器件与产品。
descriptionEn: Everspin designs and manufactures magnetoresistive RAM products for industrial, automotive, data-center and aerospace systems.
descriptionZh: Everspin 为工业、汽车、数据中心与航空航天系统设计制造磁阻随机存储器产品。

name: Atomera
whyRelevant: Atomera is a small materials and process-IP company where TCAD, characterization and customer integration matter.
relevanceEn: A niche device-technology target rather than a mainstream RTL employer.
relevanceZh: 属于器件技术细分目标，而非主流 RTL 雇主。
descriptionEn: Atomera licenses Mears Silicon Technology, an engineered thin-film material intended to improve semiconductor device performance and power efficiency.
descriptionZh: Atomera 授权其 Mears Silicon Technology 工程薄膜材料，用于提升半导体器件性能与能效。

name: GSI Technology
whyRelevant: GSI combines conventional high-performance SRAM with associative in-memory compute accelerators.
relevanceEn: Strong match for memory-system research and accelerator architecture.
relevanceZh: 与存储系统研究和加速器架构高度匹配。
descriptionEn: GSI Technology designs high-performance SRAM products and Gemini associative-processing units for search and AI workloads.
descriptionZh: GSI Technology 设计高性能 SRAM 产品与面向搜索和 AI 负载的 Gemini 关联处理器。

name: Alif Semiconductor
whyRelevant: Alif builds low-power edge-AI microcontrollers, combining SoC design, verification, embedded software and ML deployment.
relevanceEn: A direct Bay Area target for RTL, verification and hardware-software co-design.
relevanceZh: 湾区 RTL、验证与软硬件协同设计的直接目标。
descriptionEn: Alif Semiconductor develops secure, power-efficient microcontrollers and fusion processors with embedded neural accelerators.
descriptionZh: Alif Semiconductor 研发安全、低功耗的微控制器与融合处理器，并集成神经网络加速器。

name: proteanTecs
whyRelevant: proteanTecs embeds monitors in chips and analyzes fleet telemetry, closely matching automated silicon diagnostics.
relevanceEn: One of the clearest targets for the Silicon Harness and diagnostic-agent narrative.
relevanceZh: 与 Silicon Harness 和诊断 Agent 叙事最匹配的公司之一。
descriptionEn: proteanTecs provides silicon lifecycle management using embedded on-chip agents, telemetry and cloud analytics to monitor performance and reliability.
descriptionZh: proteanTecs 通过片上监测单元、遥测与云分析提供芯片全生命周期管理，监控性能与可靠性。

name: Cornelis Networks
whyRelevant: Cornelis develops HPC interconnect silicon and software, creating architecture, RTL, verification and performance roles.
relevanceEn: A strong architecture target for NoC, networking and performance modeling.
